query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "agentic environment engineering for large language models: a survey of" linguistics
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (b) and (f) by providing a canonical dataset (Linguistics Olympiad problems) and a theoretical framework for using linguistic puzzles as benchmarks for Large Language Models, which directly supports the "linguistics" and "LLM" components of the user's survey on agentic environment engineering. It establishes the empirical population and alternative vocabulary (puzzles/corpus) necessary for a literature review on LLMs in linguistics.
